name: Flames (Conduit Force of Nature)
body:
A connection to the flames is a connection to the heat in the world. They are suffused with the energies of the fires, sun and radiating heat around them.

Manifestation: The conduit’s connection to the flames can manifest in many ways, a constant warm body temperature, glowing orange or yellow eyes, a subtle smoke rising from one’s body, or red hair that waves like living flames.

Communing: Communing with the flames could be staring into an open flame, cooking food, warming up under a blanket, or basking in the warmth of the sun.

Connection Spells: (1st-level/0th) – spark (2nd-level/1st) – burning hands (4th-level/2nd) – pyrotechnics (6th-level/3rd) – fireball (8th-level/4th) – fire shield (10th-level/5th) – fire snake (12th-level/6th) – sirocco (14th-level/7th) – firebrand (16th-level/8th) – incendiary cloud (18th-level/9th) – meteor swarm

Added Spells to Learn: Spells with the fire descriptor, spells that deal fire damage, or spells that involve sand.

This includes spells that summon or transform but only if it grants the fire descriptor or involves a creature with the fire subtype.

Primal Empathy: The conduits may communicate with animals from hot regions or near hot areas like volcanoes and creatures with the fire subtype (such as fire elementals and some outsiders).

Natural Skill: Intimidate

Natural Movement: If subject to fire damage, regardless of the fire damage actually hurts them, the conduit increases their base speed by 5 feet.

Continual Flame (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, so long as the conduit has at least 1 primal point remaining, they deal 1 fire damage with any melee attacks they make and 1 additional fire damage per spell level of any spell that deals fire damage they cast.

Additionally, they can expend a primal point to launch a beam of fire, making a ranged touch attack with a range of 60 feet. On a hit, they deal 1d8 fire damage per two class levels they possess. If the conduit has 1 primal point remaining after expending a point in this way, the fire damage dealt is increased by 1 per d8 of dice damage dealt. This ray of fire can ignite flammable objects.

Born of the Flames (Ex)

At 5th level, so long as the conduit has at least 1 primal point remaining, they gain a fire resistance of 10. At 13th level, this becomes immunity.

Additionally, the conduit has a bonus on saves vs. hot environments equal to their class level regardless of if they have any primal points remaining.

Healing Flames (Su)

Beginning with 9th level, the conduit can expend a primal point as a swift action to heal a target with a spell or ability that deals fire damage. The next fire effect they cast, they can select up to a number of targets equal to their Charisma modifier that are affected by the fire effect to be healed by what would normally be the fire damage dealt. This does not let the conduit select more targets than would normally be affected by the fire effect. The targets are still allowed their normal saves and fire resistance but may forgo their save if they so wish. The conduit cannot heal themselves in this manner.

Piercing Fires (Su)

Starting with 13th level, you can expend a primal point as a swift action to remove any fire resistance a target within 60 feet may have. If the target has immunity, it is instead reduced to a resistance to fire 10. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

Master of Flames (Ex)

At 17th level, the conduit no longer needs to have primal points remaining for the ongoing effects of the continual flame or born of the flames abilities and the damage dealt by the ray of fire produced by continual flame increases to 1d8 per class level.

Additionally, any creature within 5 feet of you gain your immunity to fire provided by born of the flames.
